segments.sn4.18:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati pañcasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
segments.sn4.18:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena pañcasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme kumārikānaṃ pāhunakāni bhavanti.
segments.sn4.18:1.3: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
segments.sn4.18:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena pañcasāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā mārena pāpimatā anvāviṭṭhā bhavanti –
segments.sn4.18:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā yathādhotena pattena pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi tathādhotena [yathādhotena (?)] pattena paṭikkami.
segments.sn4.18:2.2: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn4.18:2.4: “Tathā nu tvaṃ, pāpima, akāsi yathāhaṃ piṇḍaṃ na labheyyan”ti.
segments.sn4.18:2.5: “Tena hi, bhante, bhagavā dutiyampi pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisatu.
segments.sn4.18:2.6: Tathāhaṃ karissāmi yathā bhagavā piṇḍaṃ lacchatī”ti.
segments.sn4.18:5.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.

lines: Aṭṭhame pāhunakāni bhavantīti tathārūpe nakkhatte tattha tattha pesetabbāni pāhunakāni bhavanti, āgantukapaṇṇākāradānāni vā.
Sayaṃcaraṇadivase samavayajātigottā kumārakā tato tato sannipatanti.
Kumārikāyopi attano attano vibhavānurūpena alaṅkatā tahaṃ tahaṃ vicaranti.
Tatra kumārikāyopi yathārucikānaṃ kumārakānaṃ paṇṇākāraṃ pesenti, kumārakāpi kumārikānaṃ aññasmiṃ asati antamaso mālāguḷenapi parikkhipanti.
Taṃdivasaṃ kira pañcasatā kumārikāyo uyyānakīḷaṃ gacchantiyo paṭipathe satthāraṃ disvā chaṇapūvaṃ dadeyyuṃ.
Satthā tāsaṃ dānānumodanatthaṃ pakiṇṇakadhammadesanaṃ deseyya, desanāpariyosāne sabbāpi sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhaheyyuṃ.
Māro tāsaṃ sampattiyā antarāyaṃ karissāmīti anvāvisi.
Pāḷiyaṃ pana mā samaṇo gotamo piṇḍamalatthāti ettakaṃyeva vuttanti.
Kiṃ pana satthā mārāvaṭṭanaṃ ajānitvā paviṭṭhoti?
“asukaṭṭhāne bhattaṃ labhissāma, na labhissāmā”ti āvajjanaṃ na ananucchavikaṃ.
Paviṭṭho pana manussānaṃ upacārabhedaṃ disvā,“kiṃ idan”ti?
Āvajjento ñatvā,“āmisatthaṃ mārāvaṭṭanaṃ bhindituṃ ananucchavikan”ti abhinditvāva nikkhanto.
Upasaṅkamīti amittavijayena viya tuṭṭho sakalagāme kaṭacchumattampi bhattaṃ alabhitvā gāmato nikkhamantaṃ bhagavantaṃ gāmiyamanussavesena upasaṅkami.
“mayā evaṃ vutte puna pavisissati, atha naṃ gāmadārakā ‘sakalagāme caritvā kaṭacchubhikkhampi alabhitvā gāmato nikkhamma puna paviṭṭhosī’tiādīni vatvā uppaṇḍessantī”ti.
“sacāyaṃ maṃ evaṃ viheṭhessati muddhamasseva sattadhā phalissatī”ti tasmiṃ anukampāya apavisitvā gāthādvayamāha.
Na me pāpaṃ vipaccatīti mama pāpaṃ na paccati.
Nipphalaṃ etanti kiṃ nu tvaṃ evaṃ maññasi?
Mā evaṃ maññi, atthi tayā katassa pāpassa phalanti dīpeti.
Ābhassarā yathāti yathā ābhassarā devā sappītikajjhānena yāpentā pītibhakkhā nāma honti, evaṃ bhavissāmāti.
Gottasamatā ca āvāhavivāhayogyatāvasena daṭṭhabbā, na ekagottatāvasena.
Tāsaṃ sampattiyāti tāsaṃ dānaṃ dhammassavanañcāti tassā duvidhāyapi sampattiyā.
Ñāṇaṃ nāma āvajjanapubbakaṃ, tasmā ajānanassa “anāvajjanatāyā”ti kāraṇaṃ vatvā sesakāraṇaṃ vadanto “buddhānan”tiādimāha.
Tena na kevalaṃ bhagavā uppaṇḍanaṃ pariharanto taṃ gāmaṃ na puna pāvisi, atha kho māraṃ anukampantoti idaṃ visesaṃ joteti.
Janesīti apuññaṃ janesi, janento ca yathā tato āyatiṃ thirataraṃ mahantaṃ dukkhaṃ nipphajjissati, evaṃ nipphādesi.
Kiñcati maddati abhibhavatīti kiñcananti āha “maddituṃ samatthan”ti.
